Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied basic phase-change knowledge by selecting “condensed” (gas to liquid) instead of recognizing that juice placed in a freezer would most likely become a solid by the next day. It overcomplicated the situation with irrelevant factors (solute effects, freezer frost) and prematurely concluded the task without systematically evaluating the provided options or leveraging available capabilities.
